hero.title: Every photo and video from your wedding — in one place.
hero.subtitle: Guests scan a QR code and upload their memories. No app, no sign-up. You keep them all in a private gallery.
hero.trust: EU hosting · No AI training · Auto-deleted after retention

how.title: How it works
how.step1Desc: Pick the upload start date and a package. You get a private link and a QR code.
how.step2Desc: It opens in the browser — no install, no sign-up — and they upload photos and video.
how.step3Desc: Every guest sees the whole gallery. Download all your memories whenever you like.

features.title: Why WediFrame
features.f1Desc: Guests scan the QR and upload right away. Nothing to install, nothing to register.
features.f2Desc: Print the QR code and put it right in your guests' hands.
features.f3Desc: Collect photos and video clips in full quality.
features.f4Desc: One shared gallery — each guest sees every memory, not just their own.
features.f5Desc: Stored in the EU. Access only via your link. No public sharing.
features.f6Desc: One-time, no subscription. Free package to try it out.

privacy.title: Your memories are yours
privacy.subtitle: What we never do with your content:
privacy.p1: We don't train AI on your photos.
privacy.p2: We don't sell or share your data with third parties.
privacy.p3: We don't make the gallery public — only someone with the link gets in.
